author: Mark Atwood
text:
Re-classifying as 'won't fix here' per workspace canonical-template propagation rule. The lossy-as-cast pattern in query_objects is workspace-wide:

- jmap-mail-server (CANONICAL): 11 sites across 5 files (src/memory.rs:365/368/936; src/submission.rs:188; src/sieve.rs:1132/1135/1144; src/mailbox.rs:293/311; src/email.rs:834/837).
- jmap-metadata-server: 4 sites in src/memory.rs (this bead's scope).
- 6 other extension-server siblings: unaudited; expected ~4-10 sites each.

A metadata-server-only fix would diverge from the canonical and create exactly the cookie-cutter regression the propagation rule guards against. Worse, the right architectural answer is helpers on jmap-server (the foundation) so consumer-implemented backends — the kit's actual audience — get correct 32-bit-target behavior without copying the pattern.

Filed canonical-first sweep epic: JMAP-pgj7 (jmap-server helpers + jmap-mail-server canonical + 7 sibling propagation). Closing this sibling-scoped bead in favor of that one.
